```{r find non numeric unis}
#make a helper function to identify non-numeric grades for different unis

has_nonnumeric <- function(uni) {
  grades <- smarvus_filtered %>%
    filter(survey_id == uni) %>%
    pull(grade)
  
    any(is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(grades))))       
}

unis <- unique(smarvus_grades_only$survey_id)

nonnumeric_unis <- unis[sapply(unis, has_nonnumeric)]
nonnumeric_unis
```

```{r}

#Making sure everything is numeric 

smarvus_cont <- smarvus_filtered %>%
  #filter(!survey_id %in% c("brawijaya", "limerick" ,"york_can", "vienna", "hungary")) %>%
  mutate(grade_std = str_remove_all(grade_std, "%") %>%
                   str_replace(",", ".") %>%
                   as.numeric()) 


#correlation results, just to see bare r's, not used below
cor_results_cont <- smarvus_cont %>%
  group_by(survey_id) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            r = cor(grade_std, stars_score, method = "spearman"))

```

```{r metadata}
#using stuff from notes with all unis using spearman correlation
#don't really know where some things come from so investigate tomorrow, just following code in notes
library(correlation)
library(effectsize)
library(metafor)

cor_func <- function(uni) {
  d <- smarvus_cont %>% filter(survey_id == uni)
  test <- correlation::cor_test(d, "grade", "stars_score", method = "spearman") #get spearman CIs
  tibble(survey_id = uni,
         n    = test$n_Obs,
         d    = r_to_d(test$rho),
         low  = r_to_d(test$CI_low),
         high = r_to_d(test$CI_high))
}

meta_data <- map_dfr(unique(smarvus_cont$survey_id), cor_func) %>%
  mutate(se = (high - low) / 3.92)

meta_result <- metafor::rma(d, sei = se, slab = survey_id, data = meta_data)
meta_result
forest(meta_result)
```
